before.label: Soot-caked burner nozzle
before.notes: Burner flame has turned yellow-orange over the last two weeks. Stack temperature up 18 C. Heavy soot found on the nozzle and swirl vanes at last inspection. Fuel use up about 5% for the same steam output.

after_same.label: Same nozzle, cleaned
after_same.notes: Nozzle cleaned and swirl vanes replaced. Flame is blue and stable again.
